format.projects: Array of { label, id, idStatus, placeholderKey }.
format.classifyBy: The project id when id is a non-empty string and idStatus is known. While id is null and idStatus is missing, the placeholderKey is the only match key.
format.doNotClassifyBy: label, site text, or any name pattern. A name that looks like a test project and is not on this list produces a warning only.
format.id: Watchful project id from Watchful. null means this repo does not contain that id.
format.placeholderKey: Stand-in key used only while id is null. It always starts with MISSING_WATCHFUL_ID:. When the real id is known, set id, set idStatus to known, and leave the placeholder unused.
